features: TOUCHES THE DATABASE — A new column in the instalment plans, `quote_non_assegnate`: the update creates it by itself and leaves it empty in the plans that already exist; no existing data is rewritten. In addition, the instalments issued from this version on with an expense charged to a single unit write one more line per unit in the journal, «Chiusura anticipazione spesa ad personam» (closing of the ad personam expense advance), which closes the advance of that expense (before, the issue counted it twice). The instalments already issued stay as they were: the «Crediti da riallineare» (credits to realign) card of «Incassi rate» (instalment collections) lists them, with the figure, without correcting them. No new permission. The account statement per person and the ancillary charges statement are calculated when printed: a PDF already handed over stays as it was, one printed again has today's figures and dates. One mail library is updated. The changes in behaviour are listed first. After the update, reload the pages that are already open.

CHANGES: THE ACCOUNT STATEMENT PER PERSON — A person's account statement counts only the lines of the accounts «Crediti verso condomini» (receivables from owners), «Anticipi da Condomini» (advances from owners) and «Fondo Passate Gestioni» (fund of past management years). An owner who is also a contact person of a supplier no longer sees the supplier's invoices among the payments, nor its settlements and the payments among the charges: in the example of an instalment of € 500.00, a settlement of € 16.68 with the supplier and an invoice of € 1,220.00 with its payment, the balance is € 500.00 (before € 516.68), the charges € 500.00 (before € 1,736.68) and the amount paid € 0.00 (before € 1,220.00). The date of each line is the accrual date, as in the «Prima nota» (journal), not the date the movement was entered: a collection of 10/07 entered on 18/10 sits at 10/07. The lines are in date order; on the same day the debit comes before the credit; a reversal sits at its own date and, if it is of the same day as the entry it cancels, after it. If the movement was entered on a different day, the page writes it under the date («Registrata il 18/10/2026», recorded on 18/10/2026); the PDF shows only the accrual date. The totals and the final balance do not depend on the order. If you have already handed over the PDFs of the account statement per person, print them again: the figures and the dates are now the right ones (a collection dated before the issue of its instalment appears earlier, as a credit until that date).

CHANGES: THE F24 SCHEDULE DOES NOT STOP AT THE FINANCIAL YEAR — The schedule (scadenziario) gathers the withholdings to be paid and the drafts or confirmed forms of all the financial years of the condominium: once the old year is closed and the new one opened, the December withholdings, which are paid by 16 January, stay in the list, in the «Da versare» (to pay) and «Scadute» (overdue) counters and in the notice of the suppliers to classify (in the example of € 6,000.00 of fees paid in December 2026, the 4% withholding is € 240.00 to pay on 18/01/2027, because the 16th is a Saturday). «Aggiorna scadenze» (update deadlines) redoes all the drafts of the condominium, of any year, and creates them in the current year; the confirmed, paid, reversed or cancelled forms it does not touch. The cumulation of the thresholds (€ 500.00 for contracts; € 100.00 for self-employment, commissions and non-residents) does not break at the change of year, not even with a financial year that does not coincide with the calendar year. A form of a year that is not the current one carries the name of its year next to the deadline and in its page, which says that the entry of the payment goes into that year, even if it is closed. The paid, reversed or cancelled forms of the old years stay in the history, with the name of their year; the «Versato» (paid) total is that of the forms of the current year (the year of the form counts, not the date of payment), and it says so under the figure. The withholdings of past years that never ended up in a form come back with their legal deadline, even if it has already passed: if you have already paid one of these outside the program, the program does not know and there is no way to tell it, so do not pay it again. «Annulla» (cancel) removes the form from «Da versare» and from «Scadute», but «Aggiorna scadenze» redoes it at the next recalculation, together with the withholdings next to it.

CHANGES: THE WITHHOLDING ON A CONTRACT FOR A NON-COMMERCIAL BODY GOES TO CODE 1020 — In the F24 the 4% withholding on contract payments goes to tax code 1019 if the recipient is subject to IRPEF and to 1020 if it is subject to IRES. A non-commercial body is subject to IRES, like a company and a cooperative, but until 1.11.0-beta.58 it ended up on 1019: now it goes to 1020, and 1019 stays for the individual, the sole trader and the partnership. The supplier page and the XML dialog write «Ente non commerciale (IRES)» (non-commercial body). The drafts already created are redone with «Aggiorna scadenze»; the confirmed ones that are unpaid are cancelled and redone with «Aggiorna scadenze»; the paid ones stay as they were. The invoices registered before keep the code they were registered with, and the invoice page says so («Tributo alla registrazione», tax code at registration): in the F24 the nature of the recipient written with the payment counts (if the payment has none, that of the supplier page): correcting it in the supplier page after the payment does not change the code. If you have already paid the withholding of a non-commercial body with code 1019, check with your accountant.

CHANGES: THE NAMES OF THE TWO COMMISSION REGIMES — The commission regimes are now called «Provvigioni — base 50%, 11,5%» (commissions, base 50%, 11.5%) and «Provvigioni — base ridotta al 20% con la dichiarazione del percipiente, 4,6%» (commissions, base reduced to 20% with the recipient's declaration, 4.6%). The old labels, «con riduzione — 11,5%» (with reduction) and «senza riduzione — 4,6%» (without reduction), said the reduction the wrong way round. The calculation was right: the withholding is assessed on 50% of the commissions (11.5%) and drops to 20% (4.6%) if the recipient declares that they regularly use employees or third parties. But whoever had that declaration and chose «con riduzione» withheld 11.5% instead of 4.6%. If you have a commission supplier saved with the wrong regime, open its page and check that the regime is the one you wanted. The invoices already registered keep the withholding they were registered with: correcting the regime in the supplier page does not recalculate it. The box of the declaration in the supplier page is a note («dell'opera di dipendenti o di terzi», of the work of employees or third parties): the regime calculates the withholding, and the box does not choose it.

CHANGES: THE REGIME LABELS NO LONGER CITE THE ARTICLE — The labels of the withholding regimes (supplier page, XML dialog) no longer write the article of DPR 600/1973, which from 01/01/2027 is repealed by the consolidated act on payments and collection (D.Lgs. 33/2025): a label has no date to say so. The F24 guide cites, for contracts, art. 25-ter of DPR 600/1973 and, from 01/01/2027, art. 40 of D.Lgs. 33/2025. No figure changes.

CHANGES: THE EXPENSE CHARGED TO A SINGLE UNIT IN THE INSTALMENTS ISSUED — An invoice with a line on a single unit (an ad personam expense) already writes the advance on «Crediti verso condomini» with the unit. Until 1.11.0-beta.58 the issue of an instalment containing it wrote it a second time: with an invoice of € 1,220.00 in two instalments, «Crediti verso condomini» of the unit reached € 2,440.00 after the two issues and stayed at € 1,220.00 after the collection, and the result of the year's management was higher by the same amount; the owners' instalments were right. From now on every instalment issued that contains an expense charged to a single unit also writes the line «Chiusura anticipazione spesa ad personam», in credit on «Crediti verso condomini», one per unit, with the instalment and without a person, and after the collection the unit goes back to zero. The same holds for the shares that the realignment of credits and the reversal of a collection bring to the journal, and for the ownership transfers, in which the part charged to a single unit follows the share of whoever enters. For the instalments issued up to 1.11.0-beta.58 the «Crediti da riallineare» card of «Incassi rate» lists, by instalment and unit, the figure charged twice (with the plan, the date and, if it is closed, the year) and says that the owners' instalments are right; the realignment does not correct it. An extraordinary plan generated before 1.11.0-beta.29 (the stable versions 1.9 and 1.10 included), without the allocation register, is issued with the part rebuilt from today's owners when the reconstruction matches the registered shares; if it does not match, it is issued as before and the card lists it among the plans «da controllare a mano» (to check by hand).

CHANGES: THE REVERSAL OF AN INVOICE WITH AN EXPENSE CHARGED TO A SINGLE UNIT ALREADY PUT INTO INSTALMENTS — If an instalment plan has already issued an instalment that asks the owners for the expense of a single unit of an invoice, the reversal of the invoice is refused and the message gives the way: reverse the collections registered on the plan's instalments, cancel the issues, take the plan back to draft and delete it, then reverse the invoice; the other invoices of the plan become available for a new plan. This way the program does not remove from the unit an expense that the instalments have already asked of someone. The refusal also holds for the instalments issued up to 1.11.0-beta.58 and for a credit note that removes the same expense: the note linked to the invoice (registering it, editing it if it removes more than before, or «Collega a una fattura», link to an invoice), the unlinked note with a line on a unit to which an issued instalment has asked the expense, and the linked note that removes from a unit more than the invoice charges to it. From the cart the new plan asks for the invoice net of the note. A plan that contains a reversed invoice is not recalculated: it has to be deleted and created again, and the issue of one of its instalments is refused if it would ask the owners again for the expense that the reversal has already removed from the unit; no instalment of the request is issued. If an ownership transfer has taken the plan in the settlement, the plan is not deleted as long as the transfer is there: the messages point to the steps of the «Ricalcola» (recalculate) button, including cancelling that transfer from the unit's history. The realignment of credits and the reversal of a collection leave out of the journal a share that stayed out of an issued instalment, if its closing would remove from the unit an expense already removed by a reversal or a note made with the earlier versions: the card lists it among the lines that stay, with the way.

CHANGES: THE INSTALMENT PLAN WITH A SHARE WITHOUT A RECIPIENT IS NO LONGER «DISALLINEATO» — The instalment plan that the administrator accepted with «Procedi comunque» (proceed anyway) because a share had no recipient (a cellar without an owner, an item without a millesimal table) now has three states. «Allineato» (aligned): the instalments account for what the plan asks. «Quota aperta» (open share): the gap is the one registered at generation, the accepted unassigned shares explain it and the plan has not changed since; the badge says «Quota aperta · € 75,00 (Cantina 1)». «Disallineato» (misaligned): the gap is a different one, or something changed afterwards; the badge says «Disallineato: ricalcola!» only if the plan can be recalculated, otherwise «Disallineato». A plan in open share does not appear among the plans to recalculate on the dashboard («Ricalcolo necessario»). The comparison stays without tolerance. The estimate of an item changed after generation usually does not move the plan, which asks for its own figure; the exception is an item with an amount already paid («Già versato»), because the part of it that the plan deducts depends on the estimate, and the plan becomes «Disallineato». A plan accepted before the update does not have the list of shares and stays «Disallineato»: the page says so and does not promise that «Ricalcola» will fix it. «Ricalcola» redoes the list with today's data and, if shares without a recipient remain, asks for the acknowledgement. «Rimuovi voce e ricalcola» (remove item and recalculate) redoes the list without asking: the shares already accepted stay accepted, a new share leaves the plan «Disallineato» until «Ricalcola» asks for its acknowledgement. If no shares without a recipient remain, the note and the list are emptied.

CHANGES: THE FIRST DEADLINE WITH THE ADVANCED RECURRENCE RULES — With «Abilita regole di ricorrenza avanzate» (enable advanced recurrence rules) and a first deadline chosen, the first instalment is the chosen date and the following ones are the dates of the rule after it; before, the chosen date was lost (chosen 20/01, every 2 months, day 5: the instalments came out on 05/03, 05/05, 05/07 and 05/09; now on 20/01, 05/03, 05/05 and 05/07). With the monthly rule on the day of the month the chosen date takes the place of the instalment of its month: chosen 03/01 with day 5, the instalments are 03/01, 05/02 and 05/03. Choosing a date of the rule (05/01) does not double the instalment. «Ricalcola» on a plan already generated redoes the dates with this rule. Without a chosen first deadline the dates are those of before, and the chosen day of the month also holds with the recurrence every 2 months. With «Forza in giorni specifici» (force on specific days) the page hides the day of the month and the monthly rule falls on the first of the ticked weekdays of each month: with all seven ticked, the 1st of the month.

CHANGES: THE ANCILLARY CHARGES STATEMENT AFTER AN AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE PARTIES — (1) The exit of whoever took the place of the party in the agreement ends the agreement, like the exit of the party. Ines → Sara «Scrivi il conguaglio» (write the settlement) on 1 July, Sara → Zoe with the agreement on 1 October, Zoe → Elsa «Non scriverlo» (do not write it) on 1 November (Elsa enters the agreement in Zoe's place), the end of Elsa's lease on 1 December and Teo from 1 December at 80 %: Teo reimburses Sara for his December days, € 30.58; Sara has € 150.90 to her charge (with the settlement € 181.48, € 30.58 to receive) and Ines € 178.52 in her instalments; before, Teo reimbursed nothing and Sara had € 181.48. (2) If in the same story Sara comes back on 1 December (Elsa → Sara) and Teo enters from 1 December at 20 %, the agreement ends at the return and Teo, who is not a party to the agreement, reimburses Sara € 7.19; Sara has € 174.29 to her charge and Ines € 178.52. (3) A second plan taken only by the last transfer (Ines → Sara «Scrivi» on 1 July, Sara → Ines «Non scriverlo» on 1 September, the plan «Integrativo 2026» issued in October, the end of Ines's lease «Scrivi» on 1 December and Teo from 1 December at 80 %): Teo reimburses Ugo € 39.88 (before € 30.58) and Ines has € 368.47 (before € 377.77). (4) A second plan issued after a cancelled change no longer makes Teo reimburse Ugo € 9.30 that Ugo does not have in the Wallet: in the example (Ines → Sara «Scrivi» on 1 July with «Annulla il conguaglio» (cancel the settlement), the plan «Integrativo 2026» issued by 31 October, the end of Sara's lease «Scrivi» on 1 December, Teo from 1 December at 80 %) Ines has € 288.02 in her instalments (before € 232.82), Sara € 150.90 settled between the parties (before € 196.80) and Teo € 30.58 «pagata da Ugo» (paid by Ugo) (before € 39.88). (5) A plan issued after the last transfer, that no transfer has taken, is read as if the change that did not take it were not there, even when the plan is no longer recalculated because someone else's transfer took it: with the end of Ines's lease on 1 December and Teo from 1 December, Teo reimburses Ines € 9.30 and Ugo € 30.58, and Ines has € 368.47 (before € 377.77); if instead the one who enters on 1 December is Luca and the transfer Luca → Pia of 15 December is registered after the issue, on the second plan Ines has € 100.20 to her charge and receives € 9.30, Luca € 4.20 and Pia € 5.10 «pagata da Ines» (paid by Ines). The pairs already written in the Wallet do not change: the correction is in the statement, and it also holds for the transfers already registered. If you have already handed over the statement in one of these cases, print it again: the figures are now the right ones.

NEW: THE UNASSIGNED SHARES, ONE BY ONE — At the top of the plan page a box gives the unassigned figure («Questo piano rate contiene quote non assegnate: € 75,00», this instalment plan contains unassigned shares) and the shares one by one, in the form «unit · item: figure — why» (for example «nessun proprietario» (no owner) or «la voce non ha una tabella millesimale collegata» (the item has no millesimal table linked)). It says that the instalments left them out and that the share is charged to nobody (for an income item: nobody receives it as a credit); a unit without a millesimal in the table is listed without a figure, because the other units paid its part. It also says what to do for each cause: register the holder, link the table, enter the millesimals, bring the percentages to 100%, then press «Ricalcola». If the instalments are already issued the way is to reopen the plan with the steps that the «Ricalcola» button lists (cancel the issues, and first reverse the collections if there are any). The program has no individual charge: for these shares neither the box, nor the dashboard, nor the guides promise an «addebito manuale» (manual charge) or a «conguaglio di fine anno» (year-end settlement) any more. Under «Copertura spese» (expense coverage) a line says «Da mettere in rata € 2.500,00 − nelle rate € 2.425,00 = € 75,00: le quote non assegnate accettate» (to put in instalments, in the instalments, the accepted unassigned shares), and under the item two lines say «Preventivo € 4.000,00 − non in questo piano € 1.500,00 = nel piano € 2.500,00» (estimate, not in this plan, in the plan) and «Non assegnati € 75,00 (Cantina 1: nessun proprietario): restano fuori dalle rate» (unassigned, they stay out of the instalments).

FIXES: SOME TEXTS OF THE PAGES AND THE GUIDES — The F24 guide no longer says that «Aggiorna scadenze» never does any harm: it says that it redoes the drafts and that those of a closed year move to the current year. The invoice page says that in the F24 the code of the withholding is decided by the regime and, in contracts, by the nature of the recipient, not by the value written at registration. The ancillary charges statement as a PDF writes «a credito nelle sue rate» (as a credit in his instalments) and «a suo credito» (as his credit) instead of «€ -», says «a suo credito» or «a suo debito nel Wallet» (as his credit or as his debit in the Wallet) according to the direction of the line, does not write «di cui da rimborsare» (of which to be reimbursed) on the last line when a part is a credit. The panel of the transfer says, for the days of an agreement between the parties, that the statement makes nobody reimburse. The guide «Registrare un passaggio» says that, when a plan that the change of tenant did not take is no longer recalculated, the statement reads it as if the change were not there: the shares stay with whoever has them, and, if whoever has them leaves, whoever enters after that exit reimburses whoever paid their days.

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE — (1) The instalments issued up to 1.11.0-beta.58 with an expense charged to a single unit have the advance charged twice in the journal: the «Crediti da riallineare» card lists them and the realignment does not correct them. If with 1.11.0-beta.58 you reversed an invoice with an expense charged to a single unit, or linked a credit note to it, when the plan had already collected, the «Crediti da riallineare» card lists those instalments all the same, with the figure «di spesa ad personam addebitati due volte» (of ad personam expense charged twice), even though the reversal or the note has already removed the expense, or part of it, from the unit: before correcting by hand, look at the unit's balance on «Crediti verso condomini». A part charged to a single unit that is negative (a reducing line that exceeds the rest) stays as it is: the unit does not go back to zero by itself. If the share of an instalment is exactly zero (a negative common expense equal to the part charged to the unit), the issue writes nothing and the advance stays open. (2) To reverse a single invoice charged to a single unit in a plan with other expenses, you reverse the collections of all its instalments, cancel all the issues and create the plan again. A credit note for an invoice that the program does not have (an earlier document), with a line on a unit to which an issued instalment has asked the expense, is refused and cannot be linked; it is registered on a chapter, without the unit. If the invoice has a supplier's note linked, the refusal of the reversal suggests unlinking it, and after unlinking, the credit towards the supplier in the debt position counts twice. (3) On the very day of the deadline (for example 18/01/2027) the F24 «Scadute» counter counts the form and the «Solo scadute» (overdue only) filter does not show it; from the next day they coincide. (4) Under the totals of the account statement per person the labels «Rate emesse» (instalments issued) and «Incassi registrati» (collections registered) also add up the lines of a compensation (in the example «Totale addebiti € 1.600,00 — Rate emesse» with instalments issued for € 1,000.00, and «Totale versato € 900,00 — Incassi registrati» with collections for € 300.00); the balance is right. (5) The payment to a supplier writes the payment date as the registration date: the thirty-day check of the accounting register, which compares the two dates, does not trigger for payments. (6) In the ancillary charges statement, after an agreement with whoever has the line (Ines with the line → Sara on 1 July with the agreement, the end of Sara's lease on 1 October with «Non scriverlo», Elsa from 15 October) the exit of the party does not end the agreement: Ines has € 360.00 in her instalments and Elsa € 0.00. After an agreement and a change of the party with «Non scriverlo» towards whoever had the lines (Sara → Zoe with the agreement, Zoe → Ines «Non scriverlo» on 1 November, the end of Ines's lease «Scrivi» on 1 December, Teo from 1 December) the statement does not see the pair of the end: the Wallet has Ines − € 30.58 and Ugo + € 30.58, but the statement makes Teo reimburse Sara, and Ugo is left without € 30.58; in that rare story the reimbursement is calculated separately. With an income item the way without settlement is printed with the direction reversed («€ 9,30 da restituire a Ines» (to give back to Ines) while it is Ines who has to give € 9.30): the figures and the panel are right. In some stories with two cancelled changes in a row the reimbursement can differ by one cent from the pair written in the Wallet (€ 30.57 against € 30.58). (7) With the weekly rule, and with the monthly rule on the first of the chosen days, a first deadline chosen a few days before a date of the rule gives two close instalments: the chosen date and the one of the rule that follows it (chosen Tuesday 19/01/2027, every week on Thursday: 19/01 and 21/01). (8) The program calculates the withholdings of the regimes it has (contracts, self-employment, commissions, non-residents, employment) and does not know the 0.5% withholding in 2028 and 1% from 2029 on payments to businesses, introduced by D.Lgs. 5 August 2026, no. 141. (9) The reminder of the F24 in the agenda writes the code of the «Codice Tributo» field of the supplier page, not the one calculated for the F24: for a non-commercial body with 1019 in that field the reminder says «Cod. 1019» and the F24 has 1020.
